# refactor images alias

Reshape the `images` helper ([[DOT-13]]) the way [[DOT-232]] proposes for volumes: one `image` command with explicit verbs instead of the positional `images [all|clean|pull]` switch — listing, pruning dangling images, pulling newer tags for every local image.
